intro: Mississauga's food scene is spread out, but it rewards the drive — especially for South Asian, Afghan and Caribbean cooking. Here are a few spots worth the trip.

picks.name: Butt Karahi
picks.why: Pakistani karahi cooked to order and served sizzling in the pan. Come hungry and order fresh naan.

picks.name: Kandahar Kabab
picks.why: Afghan kabobs and rice platters with generous portions. Great value for a family dinner.

picks.name: Udupi Madras Cafe
picks.why: South Indian vegetarian classics — crispy dosas, idli and thalis.

picks.name: Leela's Roti & Doubles
picks.why: Trinidadian roti and doubles, made the way homesick islanders want them.

picks.name: Happy Lamb Hot Pot
picks.why: Mongolian-style hot pot with a fragrant broth — a fun, slow, shareable dinner.

picks.name: Snug Harbour
picks.why: Seafood with a waterfront patio by the Port Credit lighthouse. Best on a warm evening.
